challenge.title: Your First Gulf Conversation
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Gulf Arabic conversation of at least 10 lines. It must include a greeting, asking and answering names, asking where someone is from, one polite request, one thank-you exchange, one question about the time, and one set of directions. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 1 and include both a man-address form and a woman-address form.
required_elements: A natural greeting using مرحبا, هلا, or هلا والله.
A name question and a name answer.
A question using من وين and a place answer.
A polite request using لو سمحت or لو سمحتي.
A response using إي أكيد or أبشر.
A thank-you exchange using شكرا or مشكور and العفو.
A time question using كم الساعة؟.
A future plan using باجر with إن شاء الله.
At least two direction phrases such as على اليمين, على اليسار, دغري, على طول, هني, or هناك.
